exclusions.source_text: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status (PS) ≤1

Participant in which the TL is a keratoacanthoma (KA), adenosquamous carcinoma, desmoplastic carcinoma, sarcomatoid carcinoma, basal cell carcinoma, basosquamous carcinoma, Bowen's disease, or CSCC in situ without an invasive component.
